scripts.forever-monolith: rm -f /tmp/forever.log; knex migrate:latest && yarn forever-api && yarn forever-worker && yarn forever-subscribers && tail -f /tmp/forever.log
scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local node . | bunyan
scripts.debug: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local node --inspect --inspect-brk . | bunyan
scripts.dev-worker: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local node worker.js | bunyan
scripts.dev-subscribers: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local node subscribers.js | bunyan
scripts.watch: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local nodemon -e js,json,yaml . | bunyan
scripts.watch-workers: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local nodemon -e js,json,yaml worker.js | bunyan
scripts.watch-subscribers: NODE_ENV=local knex migrate:latest && NODE_ENV=local nodemon -e js,json,yaml subscribers.js | bunyan
scripts.test: rm -rf ./coverage && mkdir coverage && TZ=utc NODE_ENV=test API_ENVIRONMENT=test mocha --reporter mocha-junit-reporter
scripts.test:ci: rm -rf ./coverage && mkdir coverage && TZ=utc NODE_ENV=test API_ENVIRONMENT=test nyc mocha --reporter mocha-junit-reporter --exit
